name: Tempered Inwardcurve
description: Drop both kukri from a high guard so the left and right edges land half a breath apart.

name: Gust Hookbelly
description: Throw both blades wide like wings and sweep an incoming strike off either side.

name: Suffocating Bulgeedge
description: Hook the lead wrist with one belly and pull it open while the other blade stays raised.

name: Torrent Notch
description: Hop forward and land with both blades already cutting in the first beat of the step.

name: Galvanizing Heavytip
description: Feel the weight of both blades at once and read from them the opponent's balance.

name: Tempered Lopstroke
description: Link the qi fields in both blades so the two chops hit as one blow from two sides.

name: Hoarfrost Gash
description: Cross the blades over an opposing weapon and press with steady qi until it locks.

name: Ponderous Chip
description: Dive in short chops from each blade in turn until the opponent loses the means to answer.

name: Nova Horntang
description: Smash both qi-charged edges into the same spot on a guard and break through it.

name: Merciless Kinkspine
description: Spin both blades in mirrored circles with the field joining them into one ring of cuts.

name: Booming Rumble Forwardbelly
description: Gather field qi into both blades through a held breath and fall in a double cut that splits stone.

name: Blaze Pommelcap
description: Chop down from a deep stance as though lifting the blade out of a well of strength.

name: Inexorable Horntang
description: Cup the belly against the rim of the stance and stop a heavy blow without sliding.

name: Phantom Pommelcap
description: Slide forward without rising from the low stance so the blade stays hidden until the cut.

name: Verity Cho
description: Sense through the blade contact how deep the opponent's qi reserve runs.

name: Blaze Whump
description: Let qi fill the blade gradually over three breaths and chop with the whole stored weight.

name: Rumbleslash
description: Spill the spare qi from the first chop into a quick backcut across the rim of the guard.

name: Kinkspine
description: Pool qi in the legs and hold the blade across the body until the blow loses its force.

name: Sanguine Chopmass
description: Draw the stored field from the dantian in a long breath and hew down with all of it at once.

name: Glint Hookbelly
description: Meet a blow with a rising mass of qi and send the weight back into the attacker.

name: Tempered Slash
description: Stand still while the whole reserve rises into the edge then pour it out in a single cleaving blow.

name: Chimekink
description: Hold the guard on the left track and turn a strike aside with the spine.

name: Rumblekink
description: Cut on the right track while the left track holds the guard in place.

name: Torrent Slash
description: Turn the hip to switch the guard and cut tracks without breaking the line of the feet.

name: Overbearing Whump
description: Hook the opponent's arm with the belly while the guard track keeps their other hand busy.

name: Heavytip Vigil
description: Feel two separate qi pulses in the blade and read how the opponent answers each.

name: Gustkink
description: Cut and guard in the same swing by sending qi down both tracks at once.

name: Sanguine Forwardbelly
description: Split the qi into two flows and strike at the guard and the body in one blow.

name: Gust Chopmass
description: Slip along a line parallel to the attack so the strike runs past at arm's length.

name: Tempered Notch
description: Hold both qi tracks at full pull and drop an overhead chop that carries the weight of each.

name: Irongash
description: Cross the guard track over the cutting track at the moment of impact to tear through armor.

name: Glintkink
description: Send a mirrored track of qi up the blade to throw a strike back along its own line.

name: Eviscerating Cho
description: Merge both tracks of qi into a single edge for one chop that the eye cannot separate.

name: Gust Lopstroke
description: Chop from a raised roost position onto the foe's lifted guard.

name: Gustchip
description: Step off a falling blow as lightly as a feather and let it pass the body.

name: Prescient Inwardcurve
description: Read the whole azure sky of the fight from a raised guard and mark every moving foe.

name: Berserk Bulgeedge
description: Rise on a pulse of qi and cut upward through the opponent's guard as the body climbs.

name: Pitiless Lopstroke
description: Wheel in a half circle around the guard and strike from the quarter the foe cannot see.

name: Chospine
description: Spread the field qi in a screen beside the blade and take a strike before it reaches the arm.

name: Shattering Gash
description: Hold at the top of a leap through one drawn breath and cleave down along the stoop.

name: Inwardcurve Devastation
description: Sweep the blade low in a retreating arc that keeps close foes from following up.

name: Novacho
description: Cross the span of the fight in one flash and strike from above before the afterimage fades.

name: Grievous Gash
description: Reap with both curved blades together in a low crossing cut at the legs.

name: Flintlike Heavytip
description: Close the two bellies together in front of the body and stop a strike where it falls.

name: Waistflash
description: Pivot a full half turn with both blades extended and land facing a fresh opponent.

name: Remnant Forwardbelly
description: Read the spacing in a rank of foes to find where one sweep reaches the most.

name: Thorn Whump
description: Hook two weapons at once between the bellies and pull them down and apart.

name: Chipscourge
description: Feed the field into both blades and sweep them across the front of a line of foes.

name: Mayhem Chip
description: Hook with both curves and draw backward so the nearest foes are dragged off their stance.

name: Hourchip
description: Keep both blades reaping in a steady rhythm that holds a line of foes back.

name: Mayhem Kinkspine
description: Cut two crescents one above the other so foes cannot duck under or leap over them.

name: Mangling Hookbelly
description: Pour the field qi through both blades and sweep them in a long hold that clears a wide front.

name: Blaze Notch
description: Throw both crescents out then draw them back so the return cut meets those who closed the gap.

name: Glint Slash
description: Gather both blades into one long qi edge and hew through the heaviest shield in the front rank.

name: Downpour Chopmass
description: Gather the field through a held breath and reap an arc so wide that no rank stands within it.

name: Titanic Pommelcap
description: Bring each heavy blade down in turn at the pace of slow water yet with full weight.

name: Iron Horntang
description: Settle both blades low like stones in a riverbed and take a blow without moving them.

name: Granite Cho
description: Drift sideways at a slow pace so the opponent's strike arrives at empty space.

name: Chimewaist
description: Read from the blade's response how freely the opponent's own qi flows.

name: Hoarfrost Chip
description: Hook the foe's arm with a heavy blade and pull it slowly across the body.

name: Grievous Cho
description: Raise both blades and bring a tide of meridian qi down with a heavy overhand chop.

name: Chime Chopmass
description: Take the first blow slowly on both spines and lead the attacker's force away from the target.

name: Blistering Chip
description: Grind the two blades across a pinned guard until the guard sinks and the foe gives up ground.

name: Hoarfrost Kinkspine
description: Hold both blades low in a deep pool of qi that no single blow can break.

name: Iron Hookbelly
description: Turn both blades slowly into a heavy double hew that ends with the force of a river in flood.

name: Granite Bulgeedge
description: Raise both blades through a long held breath and let the full flood fall in a double chop.

name: Wrathful Slash
description: Speak the oath silently and chop down on it with the weight of that promise.

name: Mightgash
description: Place each foot as firmly as on the plateau so no push can shift the stance.

name: Equipoise Horntang
description: Take a strike on the spine in the oath stance and turn it off the line.

name: Waning Inwardcurve
description: Hold the gaze steady on the foe's chest and read each shift of weight there.

name: Gyvegash
description: Bind an opponent's wrist with the belly and hold it with qi until the grip fails.

name: Iron Bulgeedge
description: Drop all the qi of the pledge into the edge for one chop that lands with deadening weight.

name: Kinkmettle
description: Hold the pledged ground with qi in the legs and let the strikes break on the blade.

name: Titanic Gash
description: Hew in a vow that repeats with each blow growing heavier until the guard gives way.

name: Facetcho
description: Stand at the edge of reach and hew back the exact weight of an incoming blow.

name: Ruinous Tempered Pommelcap
description: Gather an entire oath of qi into the blade and cleave through whatever stands before it.

name: Sanguine Heavytip
description: Ride a gust into the swing so the chop arrives with the full push of the wind.

name: Torrent Chopmass
description: Split an incoming strike on the spine as wind parts around a stone.

name: Torrent Lopstroke
description: Move with the wind at the back so each step carries further than its length.

name: Waistinsight
description: Feel the change in air pressure ahead of a swing and note the opponent's coming move.

name: Fastening Inwardcurve
description: Hook the foe's arm from the leeward side where the wind hides the moving blade.

name: Granite Notch
description: Cut a hew with a wedge of compressed wind riding the edge before the blade.

name: Notchwrath
description: Let a crosswind of qi throw the blade back across the target without any wrist effort.

name: Whump Whirlpool
description: Climb an updraft of qi to a height above the foe and fall with the next cut.

name: Dismantling Lopstroke
description: Hew in a long moving line like the front of a squall that scatters the foes ahead.

name: Booming Forwardbelly
description: Wait for the gale to gather behind the shoulders and bring the blade down with its force.

name: Gust Horntang
description: Spin the blade in a small whirl of wind that throws back darts and thrusts alike.

name: Ruinous Heavytip
description: Compress a gust into a hair-thin edge ahead of the blade and tear through the guard.

name: Kinkspine Scourge
description: Hold the heading on the foe's centre and chop down the exact line to the target.

name: Silt Cho
description: Pivot to keep the gale at the face and the blade on its heading.

name: Equipoise Bulgeedge
description: Parry a gust-driven blow with the spine and turn it along the heading.

name: Unerring Hookbelly
description: Judge from the push of the gale where the foe stands even when dust hides them.

name: Might Notch
description: Bend the cut a hand's width with the gale so it lands on the foe's true position.

name: Headlong Gash
description: Keep a steady heading through a crowd or storm and arrive on the line of the target.

name: Gashruin
description: Hold the bearing through a long breath and drive the blade through the gale along it.

name: Predatory Forwardbelly
description: Lay a ring of held qi on the ground and strike it into a cutting gust when a foe steps within.

name: Unsparing Chip Devastation
description: Cut along a heading that no gale or guard can turn once the blade has begun to fall.

name: Gashscourge
description: Reap across the front on flat ground with the full length of the curve.

name: Chodurance
description: Plant the feet wide on open ground and meet a charge on the flat of the blade.

name: Torrential Gash
description: Sidestep along the line of the horizon to avoid a rush across the plateau.

name: Chime Heavytip
description: Hook the front foe of a rush and pull so the ones behind him trip.

name: Chovigil
description: Feel the movement of a rank in the ground before it reaches the blade.

name: Silt Forwardbelly
description: Drive the reaping arc with a push of wind that carries it past the reach of the arm.

name: Wrathful Whump
description: Reap along the edge of a formation and withdraw before its center can respond.

name: Shade Lopstroke
description: Hew a standing curtain of wind across the front that no foot dares to cross.

name: Daybreak Kinkspine
description: Cut a huge crescent of wind across open ground so every foe at the front is thrown back.

name: Mayhem Slash
description: Chain reaping sweeps down the line of a retreating host and scatter it before it can regroup.

name: Pommelcap Havoc
description: Cut one arc of wind so wide that the horizon seems to tilt before it as it passes.

name: Chopmass Reckoning
description: Let the wind lift the arm high and carry the blade down into the target.

name: Ironwaist
description: Land from a leap with the blade crossed over the head to cover the descent.

name: Notchglare
description: Bound forward on the gale from one foot to the other in a long loping stride.

name: Cho Respite
description: Gauge the strength of the rising wind by its pull on the arm before the leap.

name: Overpowering Inwardcurve
description: Hook the foe on the downward fall and pull the weight of the leap through the arm.

name: Waistruin
description: Fall onto the target with one chop and bound clear to fall again from a different side.

name: Unrelenting Hookbelly
description: Skip off a blow on a puff of qi and turn the parry into a bound to the rear.

name: Might Bulgeedge
description: Hold the gale under the arm over a long leap and chop at the end of the carry.

name: Granite Pommelcap
description: Rise on a held wind and crash down with the full weight of the body behind the edge.

name: Mangling Whump
description: Leap from a cliff edge three men high and bring the blade down in a hew that cleaves the guard.

name: Blazewaist
description: Land with a thrust of qi into the ground that sends a wave of cut wind outward.

name: Merciless Bulgeedge
description: Hew at the same spot with each landing until the guard erodes like cliff rock.

name: Devastating Chip
description: Hurl the body skyward on the gale and descend with a single chop like the fall of a mountain.

name: Notchhavoc
description: Chop from a fixed stance without a single step and let the foe come to the blade.

name: Impervious Pommelcap
description: Root both feet and hold the blade across the body so a blow finds no purchase.

name: Waistvigil
description: Feel the wind break around the standing blade and learn from it where the foe is.

name: Gyvenotch
description: Hook the foe's weapon arm and hold it against the rooted weight of the stance.

name: Shattering Slash
description: Drive qi from the planted feet up the full network of meridians into a hew.

name: Evergreen Heavytip
description: Stand like a boulder in the wind and shed each strike down the line of the blade.

name: Chomettle
description: Hold the stance in a gale of blows and send each wave of force down through the feet.

name: Kinkvalor
description: Meet the strongest blow with all the rooted weight and return it along the same line.

name: Devastating Forwardbelly
description: Draw force up through the planted stance during one long breath and release it in a hew.

name: Notch Ruin
description: Stand without moving a foot while a single chop splits the oncoming gale and the foe within it.
